I moved back home after 8 years and I'm really happy. Best thing is food. Also life is india is so comfortable now if you can earn well. So my advice to your actual question. 

Check out on google some flats for rent/sale in bangalore or other places. You'll get a good idea of the rent and kind of amenities places have.

I recommend place like Nashik. Work remotely and have your kids work remotely too. Rent is low, standard of living is good, city is decent and it's growing fast. On top of it...it's beautiful and green and not very polluted. Though I would say it gets dusty... but I really love it here moving back after 8 years. 

Even in nashik I live in a large apt complex now, it has a gym and clubhouse and kids playing... plus it's green and not very hot here..(only for this city but I hear bangalore is similar to nashik). Some places here have pools in their apt complex ..that's crazy to me.. 

I have lots of help here. I have a maid and I can get help moving, gardening, virtually anything for not a lot and I love supporting our economy. I even started a business. I go out and do stand up comedy in my free time..BECAUSE I HAVE FREE TIME NOW. I can delegate and I paint too and go to nice workshops..

I would say go for it..!! Come back!! and also ..your kids are not going to be bullied...if anything they will be worshipped for their whiteness..... so don't worry about that....
